G1.symptom: RuntimeError: train-only Prompt-as-Prefix statistics were not set
G1.cause: the harness never called the model's official set_train_statistics(...) before the forward pass
G1.repair: train_only_prompt_statistics() derives statistics exclusively from raw.iloc[: scaler.train_end]; the harness calls set_train_statistics(...) before forward and fails closed if the model rejects them.

G2.symptom: CALF and TimeCMA ran on Qwen instead of their preregistered GPT-2 backbone
G2.cause: the harness passed model_id=Qwen to every LLM branch, and both constructors accept model_id, so broad **kwargs filtering let the override through
G2.repair: explicit per-model MODEL_ROUTING by declared contract, plus assert_no_qwen_leakage() which fails closed before any build.
